tei:div.tei:p: ¿༄༅/ /'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/na mo badz+ra bhe ra wa ye/ 'dir dam pa brgyud pa'i man ngag las 'byung ba ltar 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs zhig brjod par bya ste/ de yang grub na bris sku dang phyi nang gi mchod pa sogs sta gon byas te/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpa' rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ mchod gtor rnams bcu gsum ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed tshogs zhing ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje 'jig byed chen po'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ /rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las byung ba'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ /oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+ya/ puṣ+pe/ nas/ shap+ta pra ti ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod la/ sdig pa rnams ni bshags par bya/ /zhes sogs bdun rnam dag dang*/ tshad med bzhi bcu gsum ma ltar bya/ de nas/ oṃ swa bhā was stong bar sbyangs/ rang gzhan gyi chos rnams rang bzhin gyis grub pas stong pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i ma he sngon po drag tu khros pa'i gdan gyi steng du hūṃ las khro bo'i rdo rje kha dog nag po rtse dgu pa lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ ma he'i gdong pa can/ rwa rnon po gnyis dang ldan pa/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs shig khro gnyer bsdus pa/

spyan gsum bgrad cing dbu skra kham ser gyen du brjes pa/ thod skam lngas dbu brgyan cing rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ sprul dang mi rus kyis brgyan cing dbu skra dang smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser rab tu 'bar ba/ gcer bu'i gzugs can/ mtshan ma gyen du bsgreng ba/ zhabs g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ /mgrin par āḥ/ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i dpal rdo rje 'jis byed kyi ye shes pa spyan drangs/ hrīḥṣ+tiḥs bgegs bskrad/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho: dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar sngar bzhin mchod la/ nang mchod ni/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ ya mān+ta ka oṃ āḥhūṃ/ yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gzugs mchog mchog tu drag po che/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod la sngags gsum ga ci 'grub bzlas nas yig brgya bzla zhing*/ mchod bstod byas nas/ dge ba 'di yis zhes sogs bsngo smon byed pa'am/ /gtor ma 'bul na/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi ye shes pa spyan drangs/ ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ ljags 'od zer gyi spu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ ya mān+ta ka'i mthar i daṃ ba ling ta btags la lan bdun nam gsum gyi dbul/ sngar ltar mchod bstod bya zhing bzod gsol byas nas gshegs/

/'dir chos rgyal la gtor ma phul na legs par bshad do/ /ces pa 'di ni co ne'i os lā+o yes kyi chos blon dad ldan mgon po rgyal mtshan gyis dpe sngon ma'i 'phro la 'di lta bu zhig gyis dang kho bos par du brko bar bya'o zhes bskul ba ltar shāka btsun bshad sgrub ming can gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni tā yi la lung blo bzang don grub po/ /maṅgalaṃ// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ - PAGE 178-- PAGE 179- -PAGE 177-
